name: spatium
description: Time awareness for the agent: hooks tell it the real time at the start of every prompt and after every tool call, with how long the current prompt has run (excluding waits on the user). /spatium:budget <duration> <task> adds a guide budget and /spatium:limit <duration> <task> a hard limit the agent enforces on itself; the lines then show the share used, which may pass 100%, with guidance at 50/80/100%. /spatium:continue carries a budget into a follow-up prompt. Subagents get their own clock, and an orchestrator can give one its own budget by starting the Agent prompt with the same marker. One zero-dependency Node file, fails open, cross-platform.
